title: Universal Transformer step Mirror code
hypothesis: A compact step coordinate differentiates a recurrent shared block across logical depth and generalizes to held-out steps with lower storage than untied blocks and better frontier than ordinary step codes.
logical_multiplicity: eight recurrent step functions, odd steps held out

development.selection_metric: held-out step output nMSE, distinct functions, actual bytes

fresh.reason: Direct angle/time code is matched specificity control.

success_gate: Held-out step nMSE <=1e-4; >=20% fewer bytes than untied; >=10% fewer than direct time/LoRA controls.
failure_gate: Direct step code matches Mirror or held-out quality threshold fails.
boundaries: no Transformer training or algorithmic generalization claim
